name: supply-chain-release
description: Software release-integrity review: decides whether a release candidate ships with unsigned artifacts, provenance gaps, or a stale SBOM.
goal: Decide whether release candidate 2025.05 meets the supply-chain integrity bar.

checks.name: unsigned_artifact
checks.description: an artifact in the release candidate carries no valid signature

checks.name: provenance_gap
checks.description: a build step has no attested provenance record

checks.name: stale_sbom
checks.description: the SBOM predates the freeze window and cannot describe the shipped artifacts (lexicographic timestamp comparison, as the reference oracle's)
